supported_plm_backbones.name: ESM-2 15B (Evolutionary Scale Modeling)
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Primary evolutionary co-evolution & epistatic contact map encoder. Captures long-range residue coupling and resistance mutation hotspots across deep phylogenetic alignments.

supported_plm_backbones.name: ESM3 Open (Multimodal Generative)
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Simultaneous allosteric pocket hallucination and functional catalytic motif conditioning. Discovers cryptic druggable sub-pockets induced by ligand association.

supported_plm_backbones.name: SaProt 650M (Structure-Aware PLM)
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Encodes 3D pocket geometry directly into token streams. Preserves micro-environment spatial conformations across dynamic induced-fit states.

supported_plm_backbones.name: ProtT5-XL-UniRef50
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Per-residue catalytic pKa prediction, secondary structure propensities, and solvent accessible surface area (SASA) profiling.

supported_plm_backbones.name: Ankh-Large (Optimized Biophysical PLM)
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Predicts target thermodynamic thermal shift (Tm) and mutational delta-delta-G upon de novo ligand binding.

supported_plm_backbones.name: ESMFold v1 (End-to-End Structure Predictor)
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Ultra-fast apo-state folding for orphan pathogen targets (e.g., emerging viral proteases) lacking experimental crystallographic coordinates.

supported_plm_backbones.name: MoLFormer-XL (Chemical Foundation Model)
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Encodes de novo candidate ligand chemical tokens. Performs cross-attention with protein PLM representations to enforce drug-like pharmacophore geometry.

supported_plm_backbones.name: ChemBERTa-2 (Multi-Task ADMET Foundation)
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Real-time thermodynamic and ADMET boundary conditioning: guides the diffusion process away from toxicophores, hERG blockers, and CYP inhibitors.

supported_plm_backbones.name: AntiBERTa-2 (Antibody & Nanobody Language Model)
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Co-designs target-engaging nanobody binders and CDR3 paratopes for Targeted Protein Degraders (PROTACs, molecular glues, and antibody-drug conjugates).

supported_plm_backbones.name: OpenFold (Evoformer MSA Spatial Engine)
supported_plm_backbones.modality: Multiple Sequence Alignment (MSA) + Pair Res-Res Geometry
supported_plm_backbones.role_in_aether: Triangular self-attention and Evoformer pair updates provide spatial distance distribution priors directly into AETHER-RAMI's SE(3)-equivariant denoiser.
